_comment: What install.sh / bin/ksl operate on. The suite asset URL + sha256 are filled in when a release is cut; until then use --from <local ksl-suite.zip>. 'items' is the catalog `ksl list/install/uninstall <id>` acts on: id -> a directory under the software's hidden .support/. It lists what can be added or removed INDEPENDENTLY, which is why lib/ (every app needs it) and bin/ (the manager itself) are deliberately absent. Per-item release URLs can be added later for independent per-app updates.
